homograph.note: The "list of planned events" sense and the roofing rock share a spelling and a pronunciation but a learner would not derive one from the other; the link runs through writing a list on a slate board. The exam tested the list sense.

senses.definition: a list of events, items or candidates that are planned or offered together

examples.en: The theatre announced a full slate of plays for the summer.
examples.fa: تئاتر فهرست کاملی از نمایش‌های تابستان را اعلام کرد.

senses.definition: a dark grey rock that splits easily into thin flat pieces, used for roofs

examples.en: The roof of the old cottage was covered with grey slate.
examples.fa: سقف کلبهٔ قدیمی با سنگ لوح خاکستری پوشیده شده بود.
